_meta.frozen: 2026-11-12, before any synthetic or 1M+ data was generated
_meta.target: E95 = smallest epoch budget whose neighbor recall (k=15, 5000 eval points, 15-NN in input space) reaches 95% of the same subset's 500-epoch recall; log-interpolated between grid budgets {5,10,25,50,100,200,500}
_meta.d: intrinsic dimension = Levina-Bickel MLE (k=15, MacKay-Ghahramani averaging, 4000 query points, seed 0) on the exact subset to be embedded; integer-valued features dequantized with U(-0.5,0.5) before standardizing
_meta.umap: umap-learn 0.6.0 (PyPI release); adam = optimizer='adam', compatibility_layout=False; legacy = compatibility_layout=True; n_neighbors=15, min_dist=0.1, n_components=2
_meta.fit_data: Fashion-MNIST, MNIST (PCA-50), Letter, Pendigits (standardized); random subsets 1.4k-70k; 1 seed
_meta.form: ln E = sum_i beta_i * basis_i(L = ln n, I = ln d); E = exp(.)
corrections: 2026-11-12: software version corrected from 0.6.0rc1 to 0.6.0 (the version actually used for all development runs). No coefficient changed.
